died.name: Mary II of England
died.cause: when the clergyman reading the prayers for the sick paused due to being overcome by grief
died.last_words: My Lord, why do you not go on? I am not afraid to die.

died.name: Rob Roy MacGregor
died.last_words: Now all is over-let the piper play Ha til mi tulidh [we return no more].

died.name: Sarah Wesley
died.last_words: Open the gates! Open the gates!

died.name: Francis L. Dade
died.cause: addressing his troops just before being shot and killed in a Seminole ambush which resulted in his unit's destruction
died.last_words: We have now got through all danger – keep up good heart, and when we get to Fort King, I'll give you three days for Christmas.

died.name: Thomas Babington Macaulay
died.last_words: I shall retire early; I am very tired.

died.name: Sergei Yesenin
died.cause: in his final poem before allegedly taking his own life
died.last_words: Goodbye, my friend, goodbye. My dear, you are in my heart. Predestined separation promises a future meeting.

died.name: Maurice Ravel
died.cause: referring to the bandages on his head after brain surgery

born.name: Woodrow Wilson
born.last_words: When the machinery is broken... I am ready.
